source.description:
Winnie Shih-Ying Chang Portrait

Winnie Shih-Ying Chang, a Taiwanese actress born on December 2, 1979, is captured in a studio portrait wearing a sleeveless white top. Her short dark hair is styled neatly, and she gazes off to the side with a gentle smile. A gold ear cuff on her left ear adds a refined accessory detail against the neutral gray backdrop.

Known for her performances in Wo de ling hun shi ai zuo de (2019), Seven Days in Heaven (2010), and Yen and Ai-Lee (2024), Chang’s poised expression and minimalist styling highlight her elegance and screen presence.

Winnie Shih-Ying Chang with Golden Trophy

Winnie Shih-Ying Chang stands before a plain gray background, dressed in a sleek sleeveless black gown. Her hair is loosely pulled back, revealing a statement rectangular earring. She cradles a gleaming gold trophy shaped like a rearing horse, her expression warm and triumphant.

Born on December 2, 1979, in Taiwan, Chang is recognized for her performances in Wo de ling hun shi ai zuo de (2019), Seven Days in Heaven (2010), and Yen and Ai-Lee (2024). This portrait captures her poised elegance and the celebratory moment of her award recognition.

source.description:
Winnie Chang Portrait

Winnie Chang, a Taiwanese actress known for her breakout role in the film 《父後七日》, appears in a high-contrast black-and-white portrait. She wears a sheer black top with a modern cut, her hair slicked back to accentuate her facial features and winged eyeliner.

Graduating from the Taipei National University of the Arts’ drama department, Chang’s poised expression and minimalist styling reflect her refined stage and screen presence. The stark white background and close framing draw attention to her elegant posture and confident gaze.
